content: मुनिः [मन्-इन् उच्च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 122</ls>] .²1 A sage, a holy man, saint, devotee, an ascetic; मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः <ls>Bg. 10. 37</ls>; दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः . वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते .. <ls n="Bg.">2. 56</ls>; पुण्यः शब्दो मुनिरिति मुहुः केवलं राजपूर्वः <ls>Ś. 2. 15</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 49</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the sage Agastya. .²3 Of Vyāsa; <ls>Mb. 6. 119. 40</ls>. .²4 Of Buddha. .²5 of Pāṇini. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants (पियालु, पराशर and दमनक). .²7 The internal conscience (according to <ls>Kull.</ls> on <ls>Ms. 8. 91</ls> ‘the Supreme Spirit’). .²8 The mango-tree. .²9 The number ‘seven’. --{%<ab>pl.</ab>%} The seven sages.
